issues.desc: The reopen does not yet replace the stale post-promotion model across the authoritative Story scope. plan.md, CHK-001 context, and summary.json correctly require validation/chmod on staging before evicting the current dist, but scope-boundary.json still allows restoring bits after promoting dist; index.json description twice describes restoreBinExecutableBits after promotion; and understanding.json still describes the GREEN candidate as restoring after promotion. This contradiction can admit the unsafe ordering that replaces a working dist before a permission failure is known. Keep the existing files/exclusions unchanged, but correct these remaining Story truth surfaces to staging-before-eviction and rerun both INIT reviewers.
